meta.description: Jok Holk is a software student in Ho Chi Minh City building web apps with Astro, Next.js and Node.js, and indie games with Unity. See projects and blog.

hero.name: Jok Holk
hero.lead: I'm a software student in Ho Chi Minh City. I build web apps with Astro, Next.js and Node.js, and indie games with Unity. I'm aiming for a fullstack developer role.
hero.photoAlt: Portrait of Jok Holk wearing a black hoodie with the Jok Holk logo

about.title: About
body: I study software engineering at FUNiX and game programming at FPT Polytechnic. I learn mostly by building: websites, small apps and games that I finish and publish. Online I go by Jok, or Joker.

On the web I work with Astro for static sites and Next.js for server-rendered apps, with Node.js and REST APIs behind them. I also run my own VPS, where I host Strapi, Nextcloud and automated backups, and I write up each setup on the blog. For games I use Unity and C#. Rogue Adventure is the project where I did most of the work myself.

facts.label: Web
facts.value: Astro for this site, Next.js for a server-rendered dashboard that manages my VPS, Strapi as the CMS behind the blog.

facts.label: Games
facts.value: Unity and C#: THIEF, a 2.5D fighting game, and Rogue Adventure, a 2D platformer.

facts.label: Infrastructure
facts.value: A VPS I manage myself, running Nginx, Nextcloud and Strapi, with daily backups to Cloudflare R2.
